parakeet: So when I was pastoring, I started noticing that there was just this long line of people who were continuously disappointed, who were dependent, and who were ultimately just stuck where they were. And I begin to wonder if there was something you could do to move your life forward, to improve your quality of life and your state of mind, wouldn't you want to know? This becomes one of the main reasons that I share content on my YouTube and on my TikTok, is because my concern is that most of us are living severely beneath our capacity due to our attachments to superstition and magical thinking.
